mechanism_narrative: The persistent week-to-week decline in WORKPLACES mobility signals a continuing shift away from commuting-heavy routines, which reduces incidental shopping trips and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 4-week mean while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both continue to fall or remain flat for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and rises relative to baseline, more time is spent at home and fewer discretionary visits occur, pushing RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +3 points for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above +3 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous recovery in PARKS and TRANSIT indicates broader outside-home activity and easier trip chaining, which lifts retail and recreation visits over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase within 7 days when both PARKS and TRANSIT rise in the same week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls sharply while WORKPLACES also remain depressed, the combined signal implies weaker access to commercial districts and fewer shopping trips, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -18 points while WORKPLACES stays below -15 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 28 days after TRANSIT drops below -18 and WORKPLACES stays below -15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility in winter signals favorable outdoor conditions and more leisure movement, which spills over into retail outings and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS turns positive after being negative in the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after PARKS crosses from negative to positive.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while RETAIL_REC remains below baseline, households substitute toward utilitarian trips and delay discretionary shopping, keeping retail-and-recreation mobility weak over the next month.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above +8 points for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises toward or above baseline despite GROCERY_PHARM staying above +8 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued easing in TRANSIT mobility indicates less cross-city movement and weaker access to retail clusters, which should keep RETAIL_REC trending downward over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the following week while TRANSIT remains below -15 and continues declining.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rebound together from their current lows, commuting access and after-work shopping opportunities improve, producing a higher RETAIL_REC level over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by at least 2 points and TRANSIT rises by at least 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean even after WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each rise by at least 2 points in the same week.
